title: Sugar Space Arts Warehouse

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Sugar Space Arts Warehouse is available for a wide range of arts and community events. Our venue is the perfect setting for special occasions, performances, fundraisers, business gatherings, children’s and adult birthday parties, celebrations of life, quinceañeras, bar and bat mitzvahs, baptisms, festivals, open mics, outdoor events, and more. We are proud to be designated as a cultural facility. We can be full service with lighting and décor consultants who can provide linens, specialty effects, and event styling-or you’re welcome to bring in your own team and design your event from the ground
